`sthAnAnyAmAni pakvAnAM mUtrasya rudhirasya ca | hRuduNDukaH#foot@-carake purIShAntraSabdopalakShita uNDukaH pratipAditaH |# PupPusaSca koShTha ityaBidhIyate ||' iti | dhAtavaH sapta kathitAH, dhAtavo rasAdayaH, te-`rasA~asRu~gmAMsamedo~asthimajjaSukrANi dhAtavaH' iti | sapta tanmalA dhAtumalAH, teShAM dhAtUnAM pratipAkataH kaPAdisaMj~jA ityarthaH | saptopadhAtava iti | dhAtusamIpe BavA upadhAtavaH, yathA gomayAdiByo#foot@dadhimiSritagomayeneti tAtparyam | # vRuScikAdisaMBavaH, te stanyarajaHpraBRutayaH | tvacaH sapta prakIrtitAH iti SukraSoNitasyABipacyamAnakShIrasyeva santAnikAH saptatvaco Bavanti | trayo doShAH vAtapittakaPasaMj~jAH, dhAtvAdIn dUShayantIti | sandhiravayavAdInA sandhAnam | granthiriti loke | atra cakAragrahaNAt daSottaraSatadvayAdapi adhikA boddhavyAH | taduktam - `j~jeyaM cikitsakairnUnaM sandhInAM ca Satadvayam | daSottaraM sahasre dve nijagAdA~atrinandana:' iti | asthnAM ca triSataM matamiti | asthi sAraBUtaM SarIrasyAdhArarUpaM ca kathitam | saptottaraM marmaSatamiti | marmANi jIvasyAdhArarUpANi tAni saptA~adhikaSatasaMKyAni | tathA SirAH saptaSatAni ceti | doShadhAtujalavAhinyaH SirAH kathitAH, cakArAdatra na ca saptaSataM niyatam anyASca santItyeke BAShante; taduktaM -``dvisaptatisahasrANi nADInAM tadvinirgatAH | tAByo vinirgatA nADyastAByo~athAnyAH punaH punaH || tAvatyo nADyo dehe yAvatyo romakUpakAH | sthUlamUlAH susUkShmAgrAH patrareKApratAnavat'' iti | dhamanyo nADIviSeShAScaturviSatisaMKyakAH kathitAstASca rasavahA j~jeyAH, SirA dhamanyo nADyaSca parasparaparyAyavAcakA j~jeyAH, BinnatvamAsAM kAryatvAt | mAMsapeSya iti - nRuNAM puruShANAM mAMsapeSyaH pa~jcaSatasaMKyakAH samAKyAtAH | budhairitiSeShaH | peSI dIrGAkRutimAMsaKaNDaH, aparaiScaturasrA peSItyucyate | tathAcoktam `caturasrA Bavet peSI vRuttaH piNDo#foot@‘piNDauGa’ pA0|# GanaH smRutaH | SAlmalImukulAkArAmarbudaM paricakShate' iti | strINAM viMSatyadhikA ityanena mAMsapeSyaH kathitAH, adhikASca pa~jcaSatAt, tena viMSatyadhikapa~jcaSatamAMsapeSyaH strINAM BavantItyaBiprAyaH | viMSatervivaraNamAha - stanayoH pa~jca pa~jca, catasraSca yonau, garBamArge tisraH, garBASaye ca tisra iti | kaNDarAScaiva ShoDaSeti - kaNDarA mahAsnAyuH | ShoDaSeti ShoDaSasaMKyakAH | tadyathA - catasraH pAdayoH, hastayoScatasraH, grIvAyAM catasraH, pRuShThe catasraH | nRudehe daSa randhrANi | nArIdehe trayodaSeti | nRudehe puruShaSarIre daSasaMKyakAni randhrANi CidrANi santItyadhyAhAryam | nArIdehe strISarIre trayodaSa randhrANIti BAvaH | tAnyagre vakShyamANAni j~jAtavyAni | etat sarvaM kalAdikaM samAsataH saMkShepAt proktaM kathitamityarthaH ||1-5||atha `vistareNAdhunocyata' ityuktaM prAk idAnIM vistarameteShAM darSayannAha -mAMseti | mAMsAsRu~gmedasAM tisraH kalAH, tAsAM saMj~jA yathA - mAMsadharA, raktadharA, medodharA iti caturthikA yakRutplIhno: sA SleShmadharA yakRutplIhnormadhye ityaBiprAyaH | pa~jcamI kalA cAntrANAM sA purIShadharA | ShaShThI cAgneH sA pittadharA | saptamI kalA retodharA iti sapta kalAH smRutAH kathitAH | taduktaM suSrute - ``tAsAM prathamA mAMsadharA nAma yasyAM mAMse SirAsnAyudhamanIsrotasAM pratAnA Bavanti | yathA viShamRuNAlAni vivardhante samantataH | BUmau pa~gkodakasthAni tathA mAMse SirAdayaH ||'' iti | nanu rasAdraktaM tato mAMsamityAdikramaH tatkathaM prAgeva mAMsadharA kathitA ? ucyate - SarIrapoShaNArthaM rasAdikramo~ayaM na tu dhAraNe | ata eva mAMsadharatvena pUrvaM pratipAdya kalA nirdiShTAH parasparAnugrahAt | dvitIyA raktadharA (nAma) mAMsasyAByantaratastasyAM SoNita viSeShataSca SirA snAyuyakRutplIhnoSca Bavati | ``vRukShAdyathABiprahatAt kShIriNaH kShIramAvahet | mAMsAdevaM kShatAt kShipraM SoNitaM saMprasicyate'' iti | tRutIyA medodharA (nAma,) medo hi sarvaBUtAnAmudarasthamaNvasthiShu ca mahatsu ca majjA Bavati | ``sthUlAsthiShu viSeSheNa majjA tvaByantarASritaH| athetareShu sarveShu saraktaM meda ucyate' iti || caturthI SleShmadharA nAma sarvasandhiShu prANaBRutAM Bavati | snehAByakte yathAhyakShe cakraM sAdhu pravartate | sandhayaH sAdhu vartante saMSliShTAH SleShmaNA tathA ||' iti | pa~jcamI purIShadharA (nAma) yA~antaHkoShThe malamaBiviBajate pakvASayasthA | ``yakRut samantAt koShThaM ca tathA~antrANi samASritA uNDukasthaM viBajate malaM maladharA kalA ||'' iti | ShaShThI pittadharA nAma yA caturvidhamannapAnamupayuktamAmASayAt pracyutaM pakvASayopasthitaM dhArayati | ``aSitaM KAditaM pItaM lIDhaM koShThagataM nRuNAm | tajjIryati yathAkAlaM SoShitaM pittatejasA||'' iti | saptamI SukadharA (nAma) yA sarvaprANinAM sarvaSarIravyApinI | ``yathA payasi sarpistu gUDhaScekShau raso yathA | SarIreShu tathA SukraM nRuNAM vidyAdBiShagvaraH | dvya~ggule dakShiNe pArSve bastidvArasya cApyadhaH | mUtrasrotaHpathAcCukraM puruShasya pravartate | kRutsnadehASritaM SukraM prasannamanasastathA | strIShu vyAyacCataScApi harShAt tatsampravartate ||'' || 6 ||

gU0 - adhunA sarvalakShaNasampannaM kalAdyaM SArIraM vyAKyAsyAmaH | nRudehe sapta kalAH santi, sapta ASayAH santi,sapta dhAtavaH santi, tanmalAH teShAM dhAtUnAM saptopadhAtavaH santi, sapta tvacaH prakIrtitAH | dehe traya: doShAH santi, navaSataM snAyUnAM sandhayaH santi | tathetyuktatvAt daSAdhikaM snAyavaH santi, tAstu snAyUnAM sandhaya uktAH, dehe asthisaMgrahaM triSataM, dehe saptottaraSataM marmasthalamasti, tathA SirA sUkShmA nADI saptasaptaSatamasti, nRudehe rasavAhikA dhamanyaH caturviMSatiH AKyAtAH kathitAH | atra SirAsnAyudhamanInAM Bedosti svakarmakarttRutvAt | nRuNAM dehe mAMsapeSyaH mAMsagranthayaH budhaiH pa~jcaSataM samAKyAtAH | strINAM dehe mAMsapeSyaH viMSatyadhikA AKyAtAH |dehinAM dehe kaNDarA mahAnADya ShoDaSa samAKyAtAH | nRudehe daSa randhrANi santi nArIdehe trayodaSa randhrANi CidrANi santItyarthaH | etatkalAdikaM samAsataH proktaM vistareNa adhunA ucyate || 1-5 || mAMsAsRu~gmedasAM tisraH kalAH, yakRutplIhoretayordvayoScaturthIkalA, AntrANAM pa~jcamI kalA, ShaShThI kalA agnidharA matA smRutA, retodharA saptamI kalA syAt ityanena krameNa sapta kalAH smRutAH kathitAH | tarhi kalA kA ? mAMsAsRukmedasAM sImA kalAH, ra~jjakapittasya sthAnaM yakRut, raktavAhinI yA SirA tasyAH mUlaM plIhA || 6 ||

pada: dhAtvASayAntarasthastu#foot@- pnakShiptamidam |# yaH kledastvadhitiShThati | dehoShmaNA vipakvo yaH sA kaletyaBidhIyate ||1||) kalAH saptASayAH sapta dhAtavaH sapta tanmalAH | saptopadhAtavaH sapta tvacaH sapta prakIrtitAH || 1 || trayo doShA navaSataM snAyUnAM saMdhayastathA | daSA~adhikaM ca dviSatamasthnAM ca triSataM tathA ||2|| saptottaraM marmaSataM SirAH saptaSataM tathA | caturviMSatirAKyAtA dhamanyo rasavAhikAH || 3 || mAMsapeSyaH samAKyAtA nRuNAM pa~jcaSataM budhaiH | strINAM ca viMSatyadhikAH kaNDarAScaiva ShoDaSa ||4|| nRudehe daSa randhrANi nArIdehe trayodaSa |' etatsamAsataH proktaM vistareNAdhunocyate || 5 || atha sapta kalAH | #foot@kalAsvarUpaM-‘snAyuBiSca praticCannAnsantatAMSca jarAyuNA | SleShmaNA veShTitAMScApi kalABAgAMstu tAn viduH || dhAtvASayAntare dhAturyaH kledastvadhitiShThati| dehoShmaNABipakvaSca sA kaletyamidhIyate ||’ iti | # mAMsAsRu~gmedasAM tisro yakRutplIhnoScaturthikA | pa~jcamI ca tathA~antrANAM ShaShThI cAgnidharA matA || 6 || retodharA saptamI syAditi sapta kalAH smRutAH |

tathAcoktam - ``nABistanAntaraM jantorAmASaya udAhRutaH |'' nABerUrdhvamagnyASayaH sa eva grahaNIsthAnaM kathitam | ``agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAd grahaNI matA | nABerupari sa hyagnibalopastamBavAhi ca'' iti vacanAt | vAmaBAge vyavasthita iti so~apyagnyASayastu nABervAmaBAge ASrita ityarthaH | vAmaBAge puruShasya iti vyAKyAnaM vA tasyopari tilaM j~jeyam | tilamityanena kloma kathitam tatpipAsAsthAnamityaBiprAyaH | ata eva jalavAhi- SirAmUlaM tilamityuktamAcAryeNa | eke tasyopari jalaM j~jeyamityevaM paThanti#foot@- nAsti ‘ka’ pustake# vyAKyAnayanti ca | tathAhyuktam – “agnerUrdhvaM jalaM sthApyaM tadannaM ca jalopari | agneradhaH svayaM vAyuH sthito~agniM dhamate SanaiH || vAyunA- dhamamAno~agniratyuShNaM kurute jalam | tadannamuShNatoyena samantAt pacyate SanaiH'' iti | tadadhaH pavanASaya iti | tat tasyAgnyASayasyAdhaH pavanASayo vAyoH sthAnamityarthaH | tasya vAyoH samAna iti saMj~jA | malASayastvadhastasyeti | tasya pavanASayasyAdho malASayaH sa ca pakvASayaH kathitaH | tasyaikadeSe vA viBaktamaladhAraka uNDuko vidyate ata evoNDukAt pakvASayo BinnaH iti DuM ( tu) Duka, poha ( Ta) lakaH iti loke | carake tu purIShAntraSabdenoNDukaH pratipAditaH iti | bastirmUtrASayaH smRuta iti atrApi pavanASayasyAdhaH iti saMbandhaH | bastistu carmaKallATa- kAkAro mUtrAdhAraH sa ca pakvASayasamIpe sthitaH | jIvaraktASaya iti - `jIvatulyaM raktaM, tasyASayasthAnaM tacca `plIhA' iti prasiddhaM hRudayasya vAmaBAgASritaM Bavati | ata eva jIvaraktASayamura iti pratipAditaM j~jeyaM saptASayAstkyI iti amI pUrvoktAH saptASayA boddhavyAH | taduktaM vAgBaTena - ``tAH sapta sapta cAdhArA raktasyAdyAH kramAt pare | kaPAmapittapakvAnAM vAyormUtrasya ca smRutAH'' iti | nArINAmASayAstraya iti puruShASayeByo~adhikAH strINAM traya evASayA vij~jeyA eko garBASayaH, dvau stanyASayau ca | garBASayaSca pakvASayAntare vartate, stanyASayau kShIrASayau || 7-10 ||

gU0 - idAnIM caturviMSatitattvAnAM samAptikAmaH kathyate -- mahAnityAdi | mahAnbuddhiH ahaMkRutirahaMkAraH, pa~jcatanmAtrANi SabdAdIni etAni sapta budhAH prakRutiM vikRutiM ca jaguH | prakRutiH kAraNaM na tu kasyacitkAryamityarthaH | mahattattvAdayaH sapta mahAnahaMkAraH pa~jcatanmAtrANIti SaktiprakRutervikRutervikRutApakAryANIti suSrutaH | tathAca granthAntare `indriyANAM saMBUtInAM kAraNatvAnmaharShiBiH | mahattattvAdayaH sapta proktA vikRutayo~api ca |' atha ShoDaSa vikArAnAha - daSendriyANi SrotrAdIni, cittaM manaH mahadBUtAni pa~jca pRuthivyAdIni ete ShoDaSa vikArAH jagadvyApya sthitAH | vikArAH kAryANi | evaMBUte gRuhe jIvAtmA vasatItyAha - evamamunA prakAreNa caturviMSatiBistattvaiH siddhe vapurgRuhe jIvAtmA vasati | kiMBUtaH ? niyateH SuBASuBakarmaNaH, niGraH ApannaH | punaH kiMBUtaH ? svAntastavAn svAntaM mana eva dUto yasya saH manodUtayukta ityarthaH | sa jIvAtmA dehI kathyate ityAha - sa jIvAtmA pApAdiBiH manasA kRutrimaiH karmabandhanairvyApto baddhaSca dehI kathyate | deho~asyAstIti dehI jIvAtmA ||68-71 ||

pada: mahAnaha~gkRutiH pa~jcatanmAtrANi pRuthakpRuthak | prakRutirvikRutiScaiba saptaitAni budhA jaguH || 68 || daSendriyANi cittaM ca mahABUtAni pa~jca ca | vikArAH ShoDaSa j~jeyAH sarvaM vyApya jagatsthitAH || 69 || evaM caturviMSatiBistattvaiH siddhe vapurgRuhe | jIvAtmA niyato nityo vasati svAntadUtavAn || 70 || sa dehI kathyate pApapuNyaduHKasuKAdiBiH | vyApto baddhaSca manasA kRutrimaiH karmabandhanaiH || 71 ||

vya_text: dI0 - karmabandhanairbaddhaSceti yaduktaM tadidAnIM tasya bandhanAnyAha - kAmakrodhAviti | tasya dehina iti pUrvoktasya puruShasya kAmAdayo bandhanAya BavantItyarthaH | kAmo manasaH saMkalpaviSeShaH, taduktaM - `strIShu jAto manuShyANAM strINAM ca puruSheShu vA | parasparakRutaH snehaH kAma ityaBidhIyate' iti | krodhastu manaso vyAdhirUpo hiMsAtmakaH | tathAhi `yadUShmA hRudayA~jjantoH samuttiShThati vai sakRut | parahiMsAtmakaH kleSaH krodha ityaBidhIyate iti | loBo gardhaH tRuShNA | tathAcoktaM - `parArthaM paraBogAMSca parasAmarthyameva ca | dRuShTvA SrutvA ca yA tRuShNA jAyate loBa eva saH' iti | mohastu mithyAvabodhaH sarvapApastvaM yathA - ?aSreyaHSreyasormadhye BramaNaM saMSayo Bavet | mithyAj~jAnaM tu taM prAhurahite hitadarSanam iti | aha~gkAro~aBimAnavyApAralakShaNaH | yathA - `ahamityaBimAnena yaH kriyAsu pravartate | kAryakAraNayuktasta tadaha~gkAralakShaNam' iti | daSendriyANi prasiddhAni buddhiSceti manovyApAraH || 72 ||
gU0 - tasya dehino yAni bandhAya Bavanti tAnyAha - tasya dehino jIvasya kAmAdayo bandhAya BavantIti yojanA || 72 ||

pada: kamAkrodhau loBamohAvaha~gkAraSca pa~jcamaH | daSendriyANi buddhiSca tasya bandhAya dehinaH ||72||

vya_text: dI0 - yena baddho muktaSca Bavati suKaduHKe ca BavatastatprakAramAha - idAnIM bandhanamAha - prApnotIti | aj~jAnAditi mohAdbandhanaM kleSamApnotIti puruSha iti SeShaH, sa eva puruSha Atmaj~jAnAddharmAdharmavicAraNAnmucyate bandhanAdeva, kaivalyaM prApnotIti BAvaH | ata eva vyAdhistu duHKayogakRudBavati tat suKAvarohamArogyamiti tadduHKayogakRuditi tat tayoH SarIraSarIriNoH SarIramanasoriti kecit, duHKasaMyogakRuditi duHKaM tu svaBAvataH pratikUlavedanIyam | suKaM tu svaBAvato~anukUlavedanIyam | ArogyaM svAsthyavyApAralakShaNam | iti sRuShTikramaSArIram || 73 || iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaSrIBAvasiMhAtmajena ADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAM prathamaKaNDe kalAdikAKyAnaM nAma pa~jcamo~adhyAyaH || 5 ||

gU0 - aj~jAnAtkarmAdiBirvyAptaH bandhaM prApnoti | Atmaj~jAnAt tattvaj~jAnAt mucyate janmAdiBiriti SeShaH | vyAdhistu taddu:KayogakRut tasya dehinaH duHKayogaM karotItyarthaH | taddu:KasaMyogAdvyAdhaya iti suSrutoktavyAdhilakShaNatvAt ArogyaM tu tatsuKAvahaM BavatIti sambandhaH | iti sRuShTikramakathanam || 73 || iti SrISAr~ggadharagUDhArthadIpikAyAM SArIrakalAdikathanasRuShTikramakathanAdhyAyaH || 5 ||

pada: Apnoti bandhamaj~jAnAdAtmaj~jAnAcca mucyate | taddu:KayogakRudvyAdhirArogyaM tatsuKAvaham || 73 || iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAM kalAdikAKyAnAdhyAyaH || 5 ||
